name: Giant's Might
desc: As a Bonus Action, you magically gain these benefits for 1 minute: if you are smaller than Large, you become Large, along with everything you are wearing; you have Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws; once on each of your turns, one of your attacks with a weapon or Unarmed Strike deals an extra 1d6 damage (1d8 at level 10, 1d10 at level 18). Uses = your Proficiency Bonus, regained on a Long Rest.
